title: Visit list items
summary: Lua: Visit list items. Add fish to the table.
introduction: ipairs gives a position and value for list-style entries starting at 1.

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.

blocks.title: Visit list items
blocks.code:
for _, pet in ipairs({"cat", "dog"}) do
 print(pet)
end

blocks.text: ipairs supplies position and value. The underscore discards each position.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: ipairs stops at the first missing numbered value.
